methods: Read all complete selected after YAML payloads, original before-owner bytes and their source context/occurrence inventories.
Read all sixty full frozen scientific case contexts and the applicable primary documents, distinguishing whole supplied products, source recipes, receiving additions and explicit branches.
Inspected complete documents or precise product/formula sections of large manufacturer catalogues; search wrappers and failed retrievals are discovery or unsuccessful evidence only.
Checked all exact capture hashes and original access times; no new network retrieval was required.
Compared the full selected W02 authorship-provenance rows with exact before/after evidence objects; no human attribution inferred from a supplier URL.
